qwen3_8b_real_model_evaluation.hardware_target: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6GB VRAM, WDDM)
qwen3_8b_real_model_evaluation.limitation_summary: TransformersBackend with on-the-fly BitsAndBytes 4-bit quantization requires downloading 16.38 GB of unquantized float16 weights. Because BitsAndBytes retains the 152k vocabulary embeddings and LM-head in 16-bit for precision, the model weights alone require 5.94 GB VRAM. Adding PyTorch CUDA runtime and KV cache brings the minimum requirement to 6.79 GB, exceeding the 5.13 GB dedicated usable VRAM of the RTX 4050 Laptop GPU by 1.66 GB. In accordance with Section 3 and Section 12 instructions, inference was safely halted rather than risking further system crashes or thrashing.
